title: fxv workspace-sync command payload
description: Shared payload schema for the workspace-sync family of commands (goto, revert, sync): the outcome of moving the workspace to a target tree.

target_revision.description: Spec of the revision the workspace was moved to (e.g. 'main.8' or 'main.-.5').

created_revisions.description: Snapshots created by the operation, in creation order: the pre-sync snapshot before the preserved-files snapshot. Omitted when none were created.

error_count.description: Number of files whose change could not be applied to the working tree.

files_updated.description: The successfully updated files, each with the change the sync applied on the workspace axis.

conflicted_files.description: Workspace-relative paths ('/'-separated) of unresolved conflicts in the target tree, which block publishing until resolved. Omitted when there are none.
